pages.title: Same Spell, New Tricks
pages.text: Develop a useful existing spell instead of collecting every school.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use the native compatible-scroll upgrade shown by the Arcane Anvil. Take a result whose spell level is higher than the input.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Arcane Anvil applies its materials to scrolls, books and school armor; it differs from an ordinary anvil.
